title: Class Stats
notes: Every class has an attribute of its own, the sixth row in the Attributes window (A): Devotion (Knight), Arcana (Mage), Cunning (Rogue), Resolve (Warden), Spirit (Shaman), Ingenuity (Artificer), Erudition (Alchemist), Luck (Jester), Matriarch (Drider) and Malice (Executioner). It's paid for from the same points and strengthens what the class does best.

Breakpoints at 25, 75 and 150 points add new tricks (for example: Hemorrhage stacks to 15, residue left in the Crucible, totems linking up, minions saved from death). Points past 100 count half and past 200 a quarter.

Capstones at 300 points you spent yourself: each class chooses one of two or three, switchable in camp. A few: The Last Sentence (execute bosses below 10%), Spellweaver (every spell echoes), Shadow Twin, Spirit Web, Bottomless Crucible, Jackpot, Broodmother, Endless Blessing (auras take no passive slots) and Grand Design (a 4th Adjustment slot).
Block chance is now capped at 75% (Resolve raises it to 80%).
Game Guide: Attributes now lists every class stat, its breakpoints and capstones.
